This strand finishes the circuits foundation before microcontroller programming begins. A switch input must have a defined voltage, a valid logic level, and an interface that respects the receiving device limits.

## Required sequence

1. [Digital voltage levels and logic states](01-digital-levels.qmd)
2. [Switches and floating inputs](02-switches-floating-inputs.qmd)
3. [External pull-down resistors](03-pull-down-inputs.qmd)
4. [External pull-up resistors and active-low logic](04-pull-up-active-low.qmd)
5. [Internal pull-ups, contact bounce, and protection](05-debounce-protection.qmd)
6. [Circuits culminating project](06-circuits-culminating-project.qmd)
